# Fixtures

- `planner-export.sample.json`: one session exported from reinvent-planner.cloud on 1 October 2026 by the owner. Abstract shortened. Shows the shape `reseat rules import` must read: `id` is the Events API sessionId, `shortId` is the code (base sitting ends in `-R`, repeats in `-R1`, `-R2`), `repeats[]` lists other sittings with their own ids, `seatCapacity` is the room size (not available from the Events API), times are UTC in `startDateTime` and Las Vegas local in `startTime`.
- `catalog-sample-2026-10-01.json`: 200 of the 2,068 sessions in the reinvent2026 ListSessions pull made with `reseat save-fixture` on 1 October 2026. Fetched with `includeAbstracts=false`. Speaker names removed. One session per line, same shape as a full pull. The repo does not carry the whole catalog. The sample was chosen deterministically: the sessions the tests and demos name by code, at least one session for every type and venue pair, a few sessions with no venue or time, then repeated talks. A sampled talk keeps all its sittings. Load it with `FakeEventsApi.from_fixture(path)` or `reseat.fixtures.load_catalog(path)`. `tests/test_real_catalog.py` asserts its venue and type counts. If the sample is rebuilt from a newer pull, recount those numbers from the new file and check the fault storm seeds still reach a swap.
